title: WANT ME TO (Permission Loop) [128]
style: slinky bass house, 128 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), wobble bassline with filter sweeps, off-beat hi-hats, deep sub kick, chopped female-pitched 'want me to' hooks pitched +6, grounded male-pitched 'permission loop' chops at -4, vocal stutter edits, tension-and-release breakdowns, sidechain pumping everything to the kick, club-mainroom 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(soft pad swell, filtered chops drifting in)
(WANT — ME — TO?)
(per-MISS-ion... per-MISS-ion...)
(loop... loop... loop...)

[Build]
(filter opens, hats double up)
WANT ME TO? WANT ME TO?
PER — MISS — ION — LOOP!
WANT ME TO? WANT ME TO?
KEEL — SAYS — GO!
(riser climbs, snare roll)

[Drop 1]
(wobble bass hits, four-on-the-floor)
WANT — ME — TO!
PER — MISS — ION!
LOOP — IT — BACK!
KEEL — CLEAR!
(chopped 'yes yes yes' stutters +7)
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(half-time groove, vocal chops trade left-right)
(want?) (me?) (to?)
(yes!) (yes!) (go!)
McIVOR SAYS THE WORD —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to sub + piano motif)
(whispered) want... me... to...
(soft) per-miss-ion... loop...
(piano lifts)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare roll builds)

[Drop 2]
(wobble doubles, euphoric stack)
WANT — ME — TO! (yes yes yes!)
PER — MISS — ION! (loop loop loop!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(filter closes, chops fade)
(want... me... to...)
(per-miss-ion... loop...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(sub fades to silence)
